GOOD QUESTIONS, CLEAR ANSWERS

A few things you may be wondering

What is free, and how are service fees explained?

Initial advice and background assessment are free. Any paid follow-up will be explained before you decide. Tuition, tests, translations and visa charges are separate third-party costs and need confirmation.

When should I start preparing?

Start with your intended intake, then work back from university and scholarship deadlines. Plan tests and documents around those dates. Dates vary; requirements for a future cycle may not yet be published.

Can a Myanmar high school graduate apply directly for a bachelor’s degree?

It depends on the country, university, programme and qualification system. Matriculation, Chinese-school diplomas, GED and A-Level are not automatically equivalent. A foundation course or additional tests may be needed; the university confirms recognition.

Which documents should I prepare?

Common documents include a graduation or expected-graduation certificate, full transcripts, passport and language evidence. Translations, references, personal statements, financial or guardianship documents and portfolios depend on your application.

Can I ask for advice before taking HSK or IELTS?

Yes. Test types, scores, component minima and validity vary by programme; exemptions cannot be assumed. Select only results you already have. Missing evidence remains a gap or a point to verify.

Which scholarships can I explore?

Explore official scholarship sources, coverage, dates and obligations by destination and university. Check application conditions against your nationality, qualifications, grades and programme; each listing shows its review status.

What does passport and student visa guidance cover?

We help organise the official process, document checklist and preparation order. Visa and residence rules differ by destination. Check current authority and embassy rules when applying; approval is their decision.

Are my scores saved or sent anywhere?

Matching takes place in your browser without automatic uploads. “Save on this device” stores a local copy only when selected; you control exported files. Opening Messenger does not attach your scores. You choose what to share.
